templates.manchester_template: Class: {CorporateAgent:Class} EquivalentTo: cco:ont00000443 and bfo:0000056 some sdg:CorporateActivity
templates.verbal_template: A commercial organization that participates in corporate activities.
verbal_templates: A corporate agent operates as a registered business entity engaging in commercial transactions, regulatory compliance, or corporate governance activities. The term encompasses corporations, LLCs, or partnerships conducting market operations, managing assets, or fulfilling legal obligations within a commercial framework.
An entity qualifies as a commercial organization precisely when it engages in corporate activities.
Participation in corporate activities constitutes the defining characteristic of a commercial organization.
When an entity engages in corporate activities, it meets the criteria for a commercial organization.
templates.scope_note: Applies when a registered business entity engages in commercial transactions, regulatory compliance, or corporate governance activities. This term covers corporations, LLCs, or partnerships operating within a market.

templates.manchester_template: Class: {CorporateAuditFunction:Class} EquivalentTo: cco:ont00000938 and bfo:0000056 some sdg:CorporateAuditProcess
templates.verbal_template: A financial artifact function that is realized in a corporate audit process.
verbal_templates: Corporate audit functions execute systematic reviews of financial data and business processes to ensure accuracy and regulatory adherence. These functions utilize standardized methodologies to assess risk management and internal controls within organizational frameworks. The term encompasses the specific activities performed to validate financial reporting and operational integrity.
A financial artifact function is defined as a function that is realized in a corporate audit process.
The realization context of a financial artifact function is a corporate audit process.
A financial artifact function occurs as a realization within a corporate audit process.
templates.scope_note: Operational roles within corporate structures responsible for verifying financial records and ensuring regulatory compliance. The term applies to functions performed by internal audit teams or external auditors examining financial statements and operational procedures.

templates.manchester_template: Class: {CorporateCoalition:Class} EquivalentTo: cco:ont00001239 and bfo:0000178 some cco:ont00000443
templates.verbal_template: A corporate coalition is a continuant type that has a continuant part which is a social role or function, correcting the mismatch where realized_in (process domain/range) was incorrectly applied to a continuant subject.
verbal_templates: A group of organizations that includes at least one commercial organization as a participant. This term describes organizational structures where multiple commercial entities collaborate through formalized partnerships. The concept captures business arrangements where corporations join forces to pursue common goals, maintain shared operations, or execute joint commercial initiatives through structured organizational frameworks.

A continuant type designated as a corporate coalition possesses a continuant part classified as a social role or function, thereby resolving the error where realized_in was wrongly used for a continuant subject instead of a process.

The continuant part of a corporate coalition (which is itself a continuant type) must be a social role or function, a configuration that fixes the prior misuse of realized_in on a continuant subject rather than on a process.

A social role or function serves as the continuant part of a corporate coalition, a continuant type, and this arrangement corrects the mismatch where realized_in was incorrectly applied to a continuant subject rather than a process.
templates.scope_note: Applies to organizational structures formed by multiple commercial entities working together toward shared objectives. Used when documenting collaborative business arrangements involving multiple corporations.

templates.manchester_template: Class: {CorporateEmployee:Class} EquivalentTo: cco:ont00000647 and bfo:0000056 some sdg:CorporateEmploymentProcess
templates.verbal_template: An organization member that participates in a corporate employment process.
verbal_templates: A corporate employee is an organization member that participates in a corporate employment process. This member works within a corporate structure and contributes to corporate activities. The member fulfills corporate duties and responsibilities.
An organization member is defined as any entity that participates in a corporate employment process.
Participation in a corporate employment process characterizes an organization member.
Membership in an organization requires participation in a corporate employment process.
templates.scope_note: A corporate employee is an organization member that participates in a corporate employment process. This member works within a corporate structure.

templates.manchester_template: Class: {CorporateReputationMetric:Class} EquivalentTo: bfo:0000056 some sdg:CorporateReputationMeasurement
templates.verbal_template: A corporate reputation metric that is realized in a measurement process.
verbal_templates: This term identifies measurement information content entities that quantify corporate reputation through structured data collection and analytical processes. Practitioners apply this label when documenting survey instruments, media monitoring reports, social sentiment scores, or brand equity assessments that capture public perception, stakeholder trust, and organizational standing in commercial markets.
A corporate reputation metric is realized within a measurement process. (Simple declarative)
A measurement process realizes a corporate reputation metric. (Active/procedural)
Realization in a measurement process is the state of a corporate reputation metric. (Relational-fronted)
templates.scope_note: A measurement information content entity that quantifies corporate reputation through structured data collection and analysis.

templates.manchester_template: Class: {CourseSelectionSet:Class} EquivalentTo: bfo:0000031
templates.verbal_template: A set of course selections classified as an information content entity.
verbal_templates: A course selection set is a generically dependent continuant that comprises a set of courses selected for an educational track. This collection is tailored to meet specific educational goals or requirements, ensuring that participants acquire the necessary knowledge and skills through a structured curriculum.
A set of course selections constitutes an information content entity. (Definitional)
The classification of a set of course selections designates it as an information content entity. (Procedural/Act-focused)
An information content entity is the category into which a set of course selections falls. (Relational-fronted)
templates.scope_note: Refers to a collection of courses that have been selected for a specific educational track or program, often used in academic planning or curriculum design.

templates.manchester_template: Class: {CourtDocument:Class} EquivalentTo: cco:ont00002044 and bfo:0000056 some sdg:LegalProceeding
templates.verbal_template: A form document that participates in a legal proceeding.
verbal_templates: A form document that participates in a legal proceeding. This term covers formal written records, such as motions, evidence submissions, or judgments, that are actively processed within court proceedings to advance legal cases or maintain judicial records.
A form document is characterized as participating in a legal proceeding.
Participation in a legal proceeding serves as the operational criterion for a form document.
A form document is established through its participation in a legal proceeding.
templates.scope_note: Applies to formal written records submitted to or generated by a court during legal proceedings. Practitioners use this term when cataloging evidence, motions, or judgments in litigation, compliance, or archival workflows.

templates.manchester_template: Class: {CriminalJusticeSystem:Class} EquivalentTo: cco:ont00000870 and bfo:0000056 some sdg:CriminalJusticeProcess
templates.verbal_template: An infrastructure system that participates in criminal justice processes.
verbal_templates: The Criminal Justice System is a network of agencies and processes that enforce criminal law. This infrastructure supports law enforcement, courts, and corrections in maintaining public safety. The system coordinates investigations, prosecutions, and rehabilitation efforts.
An infrastructure system is a system that participates in criminal justice processes.
Participation in criminal justice processes characterizes an infrastructure system.
Systems that participate in criminal justice processes are designated as infrastructure systems.
templates.scope_note: The Criminal Justice System encompasses the network of agencies and processes that enforce criminal law. This infrastructure supports law enforcement, courts, and corrections in maintaining public safety. The system coordinates investigations, prosecutions, and rehabilitation efforts.

templates.manchester_template: Class: {CulturalAttribute:Class} EquivalentTo: bfo:0000019 and bfo:0000197 some sdg:OrganizationalCulture
templates.verbal_template: A quality that inheres in an organizational culture.
verbal_templates: A cultural attribute is a quality that inheres in an organizational culture. This quality shapes the values and norms within the organization. The quality persists as a stable feature of the organizational culture.
A quality is defined as an entity that inheres in an organizational culture.
An organizational culture functions as the context for a quality that inheres within it.
Inherence within an organizational culture serves as the defining characteristic of a quality.
templates.scope_note: A cultural attribute describes the quality of an organizational culture. This quality inheres in the culture.

templates.manchester_template: Class: {Curriculum:Class} EquivalentTo: bfo:0000031 and bfo:0000178 some sdg:Course
templates.verbal_template: A generically dependent continuant that comprises a structured set of courses for educational instruction.
verbal_templates: A generically dependent continuant that comprises a structured set of courses. This term represents the organized collection of courses designed for educational instruction.
templates.scope_note: A structured set of courses comprising an educational program. This entity organizes individual courses into a coherent sequence for educational instruction.

templates.manchester_template: Class: {CustomerNetwork:Class} EquivalentTo: cco:ont00000700 and bfo:0000178 some sdg:CustomerDevice
templates.verbal_template: Retained has_continuant_part as it correctly relates the network continuant to its device parts.
verbal_templates: A customer network connects a business with its clients through digital devices such as smartphones, tablets, or web browsers. The term encompasses platforms used for customer engagement, loyalty program tracking, or service delivery via mobile applications and web interfaces.
The relation has_continuant_part is kept because it accurately maps a network continuant to the device parts that constitute it.
We retain has_continuant_part since it properly connects the network continuant with its device parts.
The use of has_continuant_part must be maintained, as it correctly establishes the link between the network continuant and its device parts.
templates.scope_note: Applies when tracking interactions between a business and its customers through digital devices. This term covers networks used for customer engagement, loyalty programs, or service delivery via mobile or web platforms.

templates.manchester_template: Class: {Dish:Class} EquivalentTo: cco:ont00000307 and sdg:servedIn some cco:ont00001223
templates.verbal_template: A portion of food that is served on a dish receiver.
verbal_templates: This term identifies portions of food that are actively served on dish receivers. It captures the specific configuration of food items arranged for presentation and consumption. The term emphasizes the relationship between the food portion and the physical receiver that holds it during service.
A portion of food is defined as an item served on a dish receiver.
The serving relationship on a dish receiver applies to a portion of food.
When a portion of food is placed on a dish receiver, it constitutes the served state described.
templates.scope_note: Applies to food servings that are presented on specific receivers for consumption.

templates.manchester_template: Class: {DistrictEmployee:Class} EquivalentTo: cco:ont00000175 and sdg:memberOf some cco:ont00000545
templates.verbal_template: An organization member role held by an individual affiliated with a seat of local government.
verbal_templates: An organization member role held by an individual affiliated with a seat of local government. The role encompasses duties within district administrative structures, supporting local governance and public service delivery.
The concept designates an organization member role that is occupied by an individual who maintains an affiliation with a seat of local government.
An individual affiliated with a seat of local government holds an organization member role.
Membership within an organization must be assumed by an individual who is linked to a seat of local government.
templates.scope_note: This organization member role held by an individual affiliated with a seat of local government applies to workers within district administrative structures. The role appears in local governance, public service, and administrative operations.

templates.manchester_template: Class: {DomesticViolenceVictimClient:Class} EquivalentTo: sdg:DomesticViolenceSurvivor and sdg:involvedIn some sdg:LegalProceeding
templates.verbal_template: A survivor of domestic violence who is seeking legal advocacy or relief through a legal proceeding.
verbal_templates: A domestic violence victim client is a survivor of domestic violence who is involved in a legal proceeding. This term highlights the intersection of personal safety and legal advocacy, emphasizing the need for specialized support and representation to navigate the legal system and secure relief.
A survivor of domestic violence is defined as an individual who pursues legal advocacy or relief through a legal proceeding.
The pursuit of legal advocacy or relief via a legal proceeding serves as the defining condition for a survivor of domestic violence in this model.
When an individual seeks legal advocacy or relief through a legal proceeding, they are categorized as a survivor of domestic violence.
templates.scope_note: Applies to individuals who are survivors of domestic violence and are involved in legal proceedings, seeking legal advocacy or relief.

templates.manchester_template: Class: {Donor:Class} EquivalentTo: cco:ont00000839 and sdg:involves some cco:ont00001098
templates.verbal_template: An act of donating that involves a hospital as the recipient.
verbal_templates: This term identifies a donor entity whose donation transaction specifically designates a hospital as the recipient organization. Practitioners use this label when documenting charitable contributions, medical supply donations, or financial gifts directed to healthcare facilities for patient care, research, or operational support.
A donating act qualifies as this type if a hospital serves as the recipient.
In this donating act, a hospital fulfills the recipient role.
The recipient component of a donating act is a hospital.
templates.scope_note: A donor entity participating in an act of donation where the hospital serves as the direct recipient of the donated goods or funds.

templates.manchester_template: Class: {DonorAgent:Class} EquivalentTo: cco:ont00001017 and sdg:participatesIn some cco:ont00000839
templates.verbal_template: An agent that participates in an act of donating.
verbal_templates: An agent that participates in the Act of Donating. The agent actively engages in the donation process, contributing to the successful completion of the donating act.
An agent is defined as any entity that takes part in a donating act.
An entity is recognized as an agent when it participates in a donating act.
Participation in a donating act is the condition that characterizes an agent.
templates.scope_note: An agent that takes an active role in the act of donating.

templates.manchester_template: Class: {EarthObservationData:Class} EquivalentTo: sdg:EnvironmentalData and sdg:collectedBy some cco:ont00000352
templates.verbal_template: Environmental data that is collected by a satellite artifact.
verbal_templates: Environmental data collected by a satellite artifact. This term applies to datasets captured by orbital platforms using specialized sensors to monitor the Earth's atmosphere, land, and oceans.
Environmental data is defined by its collection through a satellite artifact.
A satellite artifact is responsible for gathering environmental data.
The collection of environmental data is performed by a satellite artifact.
templates.scope_note: Environmental data gathered from orbit by satellite artifacts equipped with remote sensing instruments. This data supports atmospheric monitoring, land surface tracking, and oceanographic studies.

templates.manchester_template: Class: {EconomicGoodsAndServices:Class} EquivalentTo: sdg:ServiceFunction and sdg:tradedIn some sdg:TariffStructure
templates.verbal_template: A service function that is traded or regulated within a specific tariff structure.
verbal_templates: A service function that is traded or regulated within a specific tariff structure. This term captures economic functions participating in structured trade arrangements governed by tariff frameworks. The concept encompasses service activities that operate within formalized economic systems, including functions involved in tariff-based transactions and regulated economic exchanges.
A service function is identified as an item that is traded or regulated within a specific tariff structure.
templates.scope_note: Applies to service functions traded within specific tariff structures. Used when documenting economic functions that participate in structured trade arrangements and tariff-based transactions.

templates.manchester_template: Class: {EnergySavingComponent:Class} EquivalentTo: cco:ont00000288 and sdg:usedIn some cco:ont00000849
templates.verbal_template: A power source component used within a heating system to improve energy efficiency.
verbal_templates: A hardware part installed within a heating system to reduce power consumption and improve thermal efficiency. The component operates continuously to maintain optimized temperature settings and lower energy usage.
A power source component is defined as a unit deployed within a heating system for the purpose of improving energy efficiency.
Within a heating system, a power source component is utilized to improve energy efficiency.
The use of a power source component inside a heating system serves to improve energy efficiency.
templates.scope_note: Applies to hardware parts installed in heating systems to reduce power consumption and improve thermal efficiency. These components operate continuously to maintain optimized temperature settings.

templates.manchester_template: Class: {EthicalInvestmentAsset:Class} EquivalentTo: cco:ont00000537 and sdg:hasPurpose some sdg:EthicalInvestment
templates.verbal_template: A financial instrument that is designated for or aligned with ethical investment strategies.
verbal_templates: A financial instrument that is designated for or aligned with ethical investment strategies. This asset serves a purpose of directing capital toward organizations and projects that meet specific ethical criteria.
A financial instrument is defined as such in this context when it is designated for or aligned with ethical investment strategies.
The property of being designated for or aligned with ethical investment strategies applies to a financial instrument to satisfy this condition.
Financial instruments that meet the criteria of being designated for or aligned with ethical investment strategies constitute the entirety of this class.
templates.scope_note: Applies to a financial instrument designated for ethical investment strategies.

templates.manchester_template: Class: {EthicalRequirement:Class} EquivalentTo: cco:ont00001224 and sdg:hasStandard some sdg:EthicalStandard
templates.verbal_template: A process requirement that specifies adherence to ethical principles or standards.
verbal_templates: Ethical requirement entities specify adherence to ethical principles or standards within research or professional contexts. Institutional review boards and compliance offices document these requirements to ensure ethical conduct during study implementation.
A process requirement is the specification that mandates adherence to ethical principles or standards.
A process requirement functions by specifying adherence to ethical principles or standards.
Adherence to ethical principles or standards is specified through a process requirement.
templates.scope_note: Ethical requirement entities specify adherence to ethical principles or standards within research or professional contexts. Institutional review boards and compliance offices document these requirements to ensure ethical conduct during study implementation.

templates.manchester_template: Class: {EvaluationOutcome:Class} EquivalentTo: cco:ont00001068 and sdg:resultsFrom some sdg:TeamAssessmentEvent
templates.verbal_template: A gain of quality that arises as a direct result of a team assessment event.
verbal_templates: An evaluation outcome represents the measurable result produced through systematic team assessment activities. This artifact captures quality improvements, performance metrics, and identified strengths derived from structured evaluation processes.
A gain of quality is defined as an outcome that arises directly from a team assessment event.
A team assessment event directly yields a gain of quality.
A gain of quality is realized as the direct consequence of a team assessment event.
templates.scope_note: An evaluation outcome represents the measurable result produced through systematic team assessment activities. This artifact captures quality improvements, performance metrics, and identified strengths derived from structured evaluation processes.

templates.manchester_template: Class: {ExecutiveDirectorFunction:Class} EquivalentTo: cco:ont00000175 and sdg:hasResponsibility some sdg:ExecutiveDirection
templates.verbal_template: An organization member role that entails responsibility for executive direction and oversight.
verbal_templates: A role within an organization that entails responsibility for executive direction and oversight constitutes an organization member role.
An organization member role is characterized by its entailment of responsibility for executive direction and oversight. (Definitional/Characteristic)
Responsibility for executive direction and oversight is entailed by an organization member role. (Relational-fronted/Passive)

templates.manchester_template: Class: {ExecutiveExecutionFunction:Class} EquivalentTo: sdg:ExecutiveLeadershipProcess and sdg:hasPurpose some sdg:ExecutiveImplementation
templates.verbal_template: An executive leadership process focused on the implementation and execution of strategic decisions.
verbal_templates: Captures the operational process where senior leadership translates high-level strategy into actionable steps. This function focuses on the practical implementation of decisions, ensuring that organizational goals are achieved through direct management and execution.
templates.scope_note: Applies to the active phase of leadership where strategic plans are translated into concrete actions, operational steps, or organizational changes.

templates.manchester_template: Class: {ExecutiveTeam:Class} EquivalentTo: cco:ont00001180 and sdg:hasMember some sdg:ExecutiveLeadershipProcess
templates.verbal_template: An executive team is an organizational entity that has member some executive leadership process.
verbal_templates: An organization composed of members holding executive leadership roles. This term describes groups of individuals who collectively hold executive leadership positions, such as CEOs, CFOs, or department heads, and collaborate on strategic decision-making and governance within an organization.
Every organizational entity classified as an executive team must include at least one executive leadership process as a member.
The membership relation of an executive team comprises at least one executive leadership process, while the team itself functions as an organizational entity.
To qualify as an executive team, an organizational entity must possess a member that is an executive leadership process.
templates.scope_note: Applies to groups of individuals holding executive leadership roles within an organization. Practitioners use this term when describing governance structures, strategic decision-making bodies, or executive committees in corporate or institutional contexts.

templates.manchester_template: Class: {ExecutiveTeamMember:Class} EquivalentTo: cco:ont00000647 and sdg:servesOn some sdg:ExecutiveLeadershipProcess
templates.verbal_template: An executive team member is an organizational role/person that serves on some executive leadership process.
verbal_templates: Designates an individual serving in a senior leadership role as part of an organization's executive team. This entity represents the active participation of a leader in executive decision-making and strategic governance.
templates.scope_note: Applies to individuals serving in senior leadership roles as part of an organization's executive team.

templates.manchester_template: Class: {ExpeditionEquipment:Class} EquivalentTo: cco:ont00001042 and sdg:usedFor some sdg:ArcticExpedition
templates.verbal_template: Equipment designed or utilized for the purpose of an arctic expedition.
verbal_templates: Designates equipment designed or utilized for polar research, logistics, and support missions. This entity encompasses the physical artifacts and tools deployed in Arctic environments to enable expedition activities.

Equipment falls within the scope of arctic expedition use when it is designed for an arctic expedition or when it is utilized for an arctic expedition. (Definitional)
Classify a piece of equipment as belonging to the arctic expedition set if it is designed for an arctic expedition or if it is utilized for an arctic expedition. (Procedural)
templates.scope_note: Used to document equipment designed or utilized for polar research, logistics, and support missions.

templates.manchester_template: Class: {ExpeditionParticipant:Class} EquivalentTo: cco:ont00001284 and sdg:participatesIn some sdg:ArcticExpedition

verbal_templates: This term identifies crew members who are actively participating in arctic expeditions. It represents the individuals who contribute to the execution and success of arctic expedition activities. The term grounds the concept of participation in the specific context of arctic expeditions and the roles of crew members within them.
A crew member is defined as an individual who participates in an arctic expedition.
A crew member is identified by their participation in an arctic expedition.
Participation in an arctic expedition defines a subset of crew members.
templates.scope_note: Applies to crew members who are part of arctic expedition teams.

templates.manchester_template: Class: {ExperiencedMentor:Class} EquivalentTo: cco:ont00000599 and sdg:hasExperience some sdg:ProfessionalExperience

verbal_templates: This term identifies an interpersonal relationship role held by an individual with substantial professional experience who provides mentorship. It encompasses guides who offer advice and support based on their career achievements and expertise.
An interpersonal relationship role is formally defined as a position occupied by an experienced individual who performs the function of providing mentorship.
This interpersonal relationship role is instantiated when an experienced individual assumes the position to deliver mentorship.
The interpersonal relationship role requires an experienced individual to occupy the position and provide mentorship.
templates.scope_note: Use this term for individuals with substantial professional experience who provide mentorship. It applies to the role of mentorship, not to mentorship programs, external agencies, or petitioners.

templates.manchester_template: Class: {ExportExecution:Class} EquivalentTo: cco:ont00001309 and sdg:realizes some sdg:PdfExportProcess
templates.verbal_template: A process profile that realizes the execution of a PDF export process.
verbal_templates: A process profile that defines the execution parameters for the Pdf Export Process. The profile captures the specific operational settings and workflow requirements that guide the realization of the PDF export activity.
A process profile is defined as the entity that realizes the execution of a PDF export process.
The execution of a PDF export process is realized by a process profile.
A process profile operates as the mechanism that realizes the execution of a PDF export process.
templates.scope_note: A process profile that governs the execution parameters for the specific act of exporting data to a PDF format.

templates.manchester_template: Class: {ExportedDataArtifact:Class} EquivalentTo: cco:ont00000995 and sdg:producedBy some sdg:DataExportProcess
templates.verbal_template: A material artifact that is produced by a data export process.
verbal_templates: A material artifact that is produced by a data export process. This term captures physical or digital artifacts generated through systematic data export operations. The concept encompasses any material form of data output, from physical printouts to digital files, created through structured data export procedures that transform information into tangible or digital artifacts.
Material artifacts are items generated through a data export process.
The production of a material artifact occurs via a data export process.
A data export process serves as the source for material artifacts.
templates.scope_note: Applies to material artifacts produced through data export processes. Used when tracking information artifacts that result from systematic data export operations.

templates.manchester_template: Class: {ExternalAgency:Class} EquivalentTo: cco:ont00001017 and sdg:hasRelationship some sdg:ExternalBusinessPartner

verbal_templates: An agent that maintains an external business partner relationship with an organization. This term applies to any independent entity or individual that engages in business activities with the organization through a formal partnership arrangement.
An agent is defined as an entity that maintains an external business partner relationship with an organization.
An external business partner relationship with an organization is maintained by an agent.
An entity is classified as an agent if it maintains an external business partner relationship with an organization.
templates.scope_note: Identifies an agent that maintains an external business partner relationship with an organization. Used to distinguish external entities from internal staff.

templates.manchester_template: Class: {IndustrialEmissionSource:Class} EquivalentTo: cco:ont00000288 and sdg:emitsIndustrialEmission some bfo:0000040

It captures the concrete origin point of emissions, such as a smokestack, exhaust pipe, or industrial furnace. Practitioners use it to track environmental impact and regulatory compliance at the source level.
A power source is defined as an entity that releases industrial pollutants into the environment. (Definitional)
Industrial pollutants are released into the environment by a power source. (Relational-fronted)
The action of releasing industrial pollutants into the environment is performed by a power source. (Procedural)
templates.scope_note: Used when identifying the physical power source or facility component that releases industrial pollutants into the environment.

templates.manchester_template: Class: {InformationCapability:Class} EquivalentTo: cco:ont00000568 and sdg:conveysInformationContent some cco:ont00000958
templates.verbal_template: An organizational capability that enables the transmission or processing of information content.

Analysts and IT professionals employ this term when assessing organizational readiness, designing information architectures, or evaluating data flow efficiency within corporate or institutional settings. The capability encompasses the structural and procedural elements that enable reliable information exchange, supporting decision-making, operational continuity, and strategic alignment.
An organizational capability is defined as a capacity that facilitates either the transmission or the processing of information content.
The transmission or processing of information content is enabled by an organizational capability.
To qualify as an organizational capability, a function must serve to enable either the transmission or the processing of information content.
templates.scope_note: Used in organizational studies and information systems to describe an organization's inherent capacity to transmit, process, or manage information content effectively, often involving specific technologies, protocols, or workflows.

templates.manchester_template: Class: {InformationItem:Class} EquivalentTo: cco:ont00000958 and sdg:encodesTaggingMetadata some bfo:0000040
templates.verbal_template: An information content entity that encodes metadata associated with a social tagging activity.
verbal_templates: An information content entity that encodes metadata associated with a social tagging activity. This term denotes the discrete unit of information that captures details about tags, users, and resources involved in social tagging. It serves as the foundational element for organizing and retrieving tagged content.
An information content entity is defined as the encoding of metadata linked to a social tagging activity.
The encoding relationship of an information content entity applies to metadata connected to a social tagging activity.
An information content entity encodes metadata that is associated with a social tagging activity.
templates.scope_note: Applies to data structures that store and represent metadata generated during social tagging activities.

templates.manchester_template: Class: {InformationSystem:Class} EquivalentTo: cco:ont00001036 and sdg:managesClinicalDocumentationData some cco:ont00000958
templates.verbal_template: A communication system configured to manage, store, and process clinical documentation data.
verbal_templates: A communication system configured to manage, store, and process clinical documentation data. These systems maintain electronic patient records, track diagnostic results, and facilitate clinical decision-making by organizing patient data into searchable, secure digital repositories accessible to authorized healthcare providers.
A communication system is set up to manage, store, and process clinical documentation data. (Too simple)
Configuration of a communication system establishes the capability to manage, store, and process clinical documentation data. (Adds "capability")
A communication system is characterized by its configuration to manage, store, and process clinical documentation data.
templates.scope_note: Software systems designed to store, retrieve, and manage electronic patient records, clinical notes, and diagnostic data within healthcare environments.

templates.manchester_template: Class: {InspectionEvent:Class} EquivalentTo: cco:ont00000037 and sdg:recordsInspectionOutcome some cco:ont00000958
templates.verbal_template: An act of observation conducted to verify compliance or condition, resulting in documented outcomes.
verbal_templates: An act of observation conducted to verify compliance or condition, resulting in documented outcomes. This concept captures the specific instance of an inspection being performed, including the collection of evidence and the generation of inspection records that reflect the findings of the observation.
An observation performed to confirm compliance or a condition constitutes an act that produces documented outcomes.
Documented outcomes are the direct result of an observation act undertaken for verifying compliance or condition.
templates.scope_note: Applies to formal inspection activities conducted to verify compliance, safety, or operational conditions.

templates.manchester_template: Class: {IntelligenceOutput:Class} EquivalentTo: cco:ont00000117 and sdg:resultsFromHealthcareAnalytics some bfo:0000015
templates.verbal_template: An information processing artifact generated as the result of analyzing healthcare data to derive actionable insights.
verbal_templates: Intelligence Output is an information processing artifact that results from healthcare analytics processes. It represents the tangible outcomes of analyzing healthcare data, such as reports, dashboards, or alerts, which provide actionable insights for stakeholders. This output is generated through the application of analytical methods to healthcare data, enabling the extraction of meaningful information to support decision-making and operational improvements.
An information processing artifact is defined as an entity that emerges when healthcare data undergoes analysis aimed at producing actionable insights.
When healthcare data is analyzed for the purpose of deriving actionable insights, the outcome constitutes an information processing artifact.
The derivation of actionable insights from healthcare data produces an information processing artifact as its direct output.
templates.scope_note: This term describes an information processing artifact generated from healthcare analytics, representing the results of analyzing healthcare data. It includes the outputs produced by processes that transform raw data into actionable insights, supporting decision-making and operational improvements.

templates.manchester_template: Class: {InterdisciplinaryEducation:Class} EquivalentTo: cco:ont00001266 and sdg:integratesMultipleDisciplines some bfo:0000040
templates.verbal_template: An instructional process that integrates knowledge and methodologies from multiple academic disciplines.
verbal_templates: Interdisciplinary Education is an instructional process that integrates knowledge and methodologies from multiple academic disciplines. It combines content, methods, and perspectives from different fields to provide a comprehensive and cohesive learning experience. This approach fosters a deeper understanding of complex topics by connecting insights from various disciplines, enhancing the ability to address multifaceted challenges and develop integrated solutions.
An instructional process is defined as a structure that integrates knowledge and methodologies from multiple academic disciplines.
