The assignment of law enforcement duties to a person designates that person as holding a civilian role.
templates.scope_note: This civilian role filled by an individual who performs law enforcement duties applies to personnel engaged in public safety and order maintenance. The role operates within law enforcement agencies and community safety frameworks.

templates.manchester_template: Class: {LectureNotes:Class} EquivalentTo: cco:ont00000069 and sdg:recordsLectureContent some bfo:0000015
templates.verbal_template: A material copy of a transcript that records the content of a lecture session.
verbal_templates: A material copy of a transcript recording the content of a lecture session. This document preserves the spoken content and instructional details from an educational presentation.
A material copy of a transcript is defined as the physical instance of a document that records the content of a lecture session.
The content of a lecture session is documented by a transcript, and the item under consideration is the material copy of that transcript.
A material copy of a transcript functions as the recorded artifact of a document that captures the content of a lecture session.
templates.scope_note: This term represents a material copy of a transcript recording the content of a lecture session.

templates.manchester_template: Class: {LegalAdvertisementActivity:Class} EquivalentTo: cco:ont00001314 and sdg:promotesLegalServices some bfo:0000015
templates.verbal_template: A legal system act that promotes legal services to the public.
verbal_templates: An act within a legal system is defined by its role in promoting legal services to the public.
Legal services to the public are promoted by an act belonging to a legal system.
The function of promoting legal services to the public is carried out by a legal system act.

templates.manchester_template: Class: {LegalEntityOrPerson:Class} EquivalentTo: bfo:0000040 and sdg:hasLegalPersonhood some bfo:0000019
templates.verbal_template: A material entity that holds formal legal personhood status.
verbal_templates: A material entity that holds formal legal personhood status. This quality confers the capacity to participate in legal relations and hold rights within a recognized jurisdiction.
An entity is a material entity that holds formal legal personhood status.
Formal legal personhood status is held by a material entity.
A material entity possessing formal legal personhood status constitutes the subject of this axiom.
templates.scope_note: Applies to material entities that hold formal legal personhood status recognized by law.

templates.manchester_template: Class: {LegalProfessional:Class} EquivalentTo: sdg:LegalAdvocateRole and sdg:possessesLegalQualifications some bfo:0000019
templates.verbal_template: A legal advocate role filled by an individual who possesses formal legal qualifications.
verbal_templates: A legal professional denotes an individual who possesses formal legal qualifications and actively performs advocacy duties within a recognized legal framework. Practitioners reference this term when documenting licensed attorneys, legal advisors, or advocates who represent clients in judicial proceedings, draft legal instruments, or provide specialized legal counsel. The role emphasizes the formal accreditation and active practice of law, distinguishing the individual by their authorized capacity to navigate legal systems and deliver professional legal services.
A legal advocate role is defined as the position held by an individual who possesses formal legal qualifications.
The filling of a legal advocate role is undertaken by an individual who possesses formal legal qualifications.
An individual possessing formal legal qualifications is the one who fills a legal advocate role.
templates.scope_note: Used in legal practice and regulatory contexts to identify individuals who hold formal qualifications and actively engage in legal advocacy, such as attorneys, barristers, or solicitors, within a jurisdiction.

templates.manchester_template: Class: {LegalTechSolutionLab:Class} EquivalentTo: cco:ont00000443 and sdg:fostersLegalTechnologyInnovation some bfo:0000015
templates.verbal_template: A commercial organization dedicated to fostering legal technology innovation.
verbal_templates: A commercial organization dedicated to developing and testing new legal technology tools. The facility fosters innovation through research, development, and collaboration with legal professionals.
A commercial organization is defined as an entity whose purpose is to foster legal technology innovation.
A commercial organization dedicated to fostering legal technology innovation operates by actively supporting the development and adoption of legal technology innovation.
templates.scope_note: Applies to commercial organizations dedicated to developing and testing new legal technology tools. The facility fosters innovation through research, development, and collaboration.

templates.manchester_template: Class: {LegislativeDepartment:Class} EquivalentTo: cco:ont00000408 and sdg:handlesLegislativeAffairs some bfo:0000015
templates.verbal_template: A government organization responsible for handling legislative affairs.
verbal_templates: A government organization responsible for handling legislative affairs. This term describes institutional structures within government frameworks that manage legislative workflows and procedural activities. The concept encompasses organizational units dedicated to legislative process management, including activities related to bill processing, regulatory implementation, and governmental legislative operations.
The concept denotes a government organization that handles legislative affairs.
Handling legislative affairs is the responsibility of a government organization.
Legislative affairs fall under the handling responsibility of a government organization.
templates.scope_note: Applies to government organizations responsible for handling legislative affairs and processes. Used when documenting institutional structures that manage legislative workflows and procedures.

templates.manchester_template: Class: {LifeguardStaff:Class} EquivalentTo: cco:ont00000175 and sdg:ensuresAquaticSafety some bfo:0000015
templates.verbal_template: An organization member role filled by staff who ensure aquatic safety.
verbal_templates: This term identifies staff members who ensure aquatic safety through active monitoring and emergency response. It encompasses personnel responsible for preventing accidents and maintaining safety standards in aquatic environments.
An organization member role is defined as a position occupied by staff who ensure aquatic safety.
templates.scope_note: Use this term for staff members whose role is to ensure aquatic safety. It applies to individuals performing lifeguard duties, not to municipal pool management activities, board members, or law enforcement personnel.

templates.manchester_template: Class: {LocalAuthority:Class} EquivalentTo: cco:ont00000187 and sdg:exercisesLocalJurisdiction some bfo:0000015
templates.verbal_template: An authority role that exercises jurisdiction over a local administrative region.
verbal_templates: This term represents an authority role that exercises jurisdiction over a local administrative region. The role encompasses governance functions including public service delivery, regulatory enforcement, and resource allocation within the designated territory. Local authorities implement policies, manage infrastructure, and respond to community needs through structured administrative processes.
An authority role is defined as the position that exercises jurisdiction over a local administrative region.
Jurisdiction over a local administrative region is exercised by an authority role.
When an authority role exercises jurisdiction over a local administrative region, it occupies its designated functional scope. (Still adds "designated functional scope" - risky.)
templates.scope_note: An authority role exercising jurisdiction over a local administrative region.

templates.manchester_template: Class: {LoginCredentials:Class} EquivalentTo: sdg:AccountAuthorizationRecord and sdg:authenticatesDigitalAccess some bfo:0000015
templates.verbal_template: An account authorization record used to authenticate digital access.
verbal_templates: An authentication credential record stores account authorization data used to verify identity during digital access sessions. This artifact captures login details and access permissions required for system authentication workflows.
An account authorization record functions as the instrument for authenticating digital access.
The authentication of digital access is carried out by an account authorization record.
Digital access authentication is enabled through an account authorization record.
templates.scope_note: Authentication Credential Record

templates.manchester_template: Class: {MachineLearningModel:Class} EquivalentTo: cco:ont00000653 and sdg:learnsFromDataPatterns some bfo:0000015
templates.verbal_template: An algorithm that learns from data patterns to make predictions.
verbal_templates: An algorithm that learns from data patterns to make predictions. The model processes input data through learning mechanisms to identify patterns and generate outputs based on those learned patterns.
The algorithm learns from data patterns, thereby enabling predictions. (Maybe adds "thereby enabling"?)
An algorithm is a method that learns from data patterns to make predictions.
The algorithm learns from data patterns in order to make predictions.
templates.scope_note: This model applies when an algorithm learns from data patterns to generate predictions or classifications. The model operates in computational environments where training data feeds into learning processes that produce actionable outputs.

templates.manchester_template: Class: {MailDropLocation:Class} EquivalentTo: cco:ont00000655 and sdg:acceptsMailForDispatch some bfo:0000015
templates.verbal_template: A mailing facility that accepts mail for dispatch.
verbal_templates: A mail drop location accepts mail for dispatch to facilitate mail collection and distribution processes. This mailing facility maintains collection infrastructure, processing equipment, and dispatch mechanisms that enable efficient mail handling and support organized mail flow through designated collection points.
A mailing facility is defined as an entity that accepts mail for dispatch.
The acceptance of mail for dispatch is a requisite property of a mailing facility.
Any entity that accepts mail for dispatch qualifies as a mailing facility.
templates.scope_note: Mailing facilities that accept mail for dispatch to facilitate mail collection and distribution processes.

templates.manchester_template: Class: {MalnourishedChild:Class} EquivalentTo: bfo:0000040 and sdg:suffersFromNutritionalDeficiency some cco:ont00000318
templates.verbal_template: A material entity in the developmental stage of childhood that suffers from a nutritional deficiency.
verbal_templates: A material entity in the developmental stage of childhood that suffers from a nutritional deficiency. This condition affects physical growth, cognitive development, and overall health during the critical childhood period. The child exhibits clinical signs of inadequate nutrient intake or absorption impacting developmental milestones.
A material entity qualifies for this classification if and only if it exists in the developmental stage of childhood and exhibits a nutritional deficiency.
The developmental stage of childhood and the condition of suffering from a nutritional deficiency jointly characterize a material entity.
To satisfy this axiom, a material entity must be located in the developmental stage of childhood and must exhibit a nutritional deficiency.
templates.scope_note: A material entity in the developmental stage of childhood that suffers from a nutritional deficiency. This condition affects physical growth, cognitive development, and overall health during the critical childhood period.

templates.manchester_template: Class: {MonetaryAmount:Class} EquivalentTo: cco:ont00000768 and sdg:denominatedInCurrency some cco:ont00000518
templates.verbal_template: A monetary amount is an amount that is denominated in a specific currency unit.
verbal_templates: This term represents a quantifiable sum of money that is explicitly denominated in a specific currency unit. It captures the precise financial value and its associated monetary standard, such as dollars or euros. Practitioners use it to document transactions, balances, or valuations in financial records.
Every monetary amount qualifies as an amount designated by a specific currency unit. (Definitional)
Denomination in a specific currency unit is the required attribute that each monetary amount possesses. (Relational-fronted/Property-focused)
Every monetary amount constitutes an amount explicitly denominated in a specific currency unit.
templates.scope_note: Used when recording a specific sum of money tied to a particular currency unit, such as USD, EUR, or JPY.

templates.manchester_template: Class: {MonitoringProtocol:Class} EquivalentTo: sdg:ClientStatisticalInformation and sdg:specifiesMonitoringProcedure some cco:ont00000569
templates.verbal_template: A monitoring protocol is client statistical information that specifies a monitoring procedure for a sensor.
verbal_templates: A monitoring protocol specifies a procedure for a sensor using client statistical information. This document defines the operational parameters and data collection methods for continuous sensor monitoring.
Client statistical information that specifies a monitoring procedure for a sensor constitutes a monitoring protocol. (Definitional)
A monitoring procedure for a sensor is specified by client statistical information, which is identified as a monitoring protocol. (Relational-fronted)
Client statistical information functions as a monitoring protocol upon
templates.scope_note: This term specifies a monitoring procedure for a sensor using client statistical information.

templates.manchester_template: Class: {MunicipalPoolFacility:Class} EquivalentTo: cco:ont00000192 and sdg:servesMunicipalRecreation some bfo:0000015
templates.verbal_template: A municipal pool facility is a facility that serves a municipal recreation purpose.
verbal_templates: A municipal pool facility is a facility that serves a municipal recreation purpose. The facility provides infrastructure for swimming, water sports, and recreational activities within a municipal setting.
A facility functions as a municipal pool facility precisely when it serves a municipal recreation purpose. (Maybe too strong with precisely when)
Any facility that serves a municipal recreation purpose operates under the classification of a municipal pool facility.
The classification municipal pool facility applies to a facility that serves a municipal recreation purpose.
templates.scope_note: This facility serves municipal recreation by providing aquatic spaces for community use. The facility operates in public parks, community centers, or dedicated municipal sites where swimming and water activities support local recreation.

templates.manchester_template: Class: {NetworkInfrastructure:Class} EquivalentTo: cco:ont00000954 and sdg:supportsDataTransmission some cco:ont00000700
templates.verbal_template: A network infrastructure is a telecommunication infrastructure that supports data transmission for a computer network.
verbal_templates: Network infrastructure functions as the telecommunication foundation that enables data transmission between computer network components. Practitioners deploy this infrastructure to establish reliable communication pathways for information exchange across distributed systems. The framework includes physical and logical elements that support continuous data flow and connectivity requirements for network operations.
Network infrastructure falls under telecommunication infrastructure, characterized by its support of data transmission for a computer network.
Data transmission for a computer network is supported by network infrastructure, which constitutes a type of telecommunication infrastructure.
Network infrastructure serves as telecommunication infrastructure, fulfilling the role of supporting data transmission for a computer network.
templates.scope_note: This term applies to telecommunication systems that provide the underlying framework for data transmission across computer networks.

templates.manchester_template: Class: {NetworkProvider:Class} EquivalentTo: cco:ont00000509 and sdg:providesNetworkAccess some cco:ont00000700
templates.verbal_template: A network provider is a service provider that provides network access for a computer network.
verbal_templates: A network provider is a service provider that provides network access for a computer network. This term refers to organizations that offer the infrastructure and services necessary for connecting devices to the internet or private networks. It includes the provision of bandwidth, routing, and other essential networking services.
Any entity classified as a network provider must simultaneously satisfy the criteria of a service provider and deliver network access for a computer network.
Every instance of a network provider must fulfill the dual requirement of operating as a service provider and supplying network access for a computer network
templates.scope_note: Applies to entities that supply network access and connectivity services to end-users or organizations.

templates.manchester_template: Class: {NetworkResource:Class} EquivalentTo: cco:ont00000740 and sdg:allocatedToNetwork some cco:ont00000700
templates.verbal_template: A network resource is a resource that is allocated to a computer network.
verbal_templates: This resource is allocated to a computer network to support communication, computation, or data management tasks. Practitioners provision it to enable service delivery, manage bandwidth, or maintain system availability in distributed computing environments.
[Definitional] Every network resource constitutes a member of the resource category allocated to a computer network.
[Relational-fronted] Allocation to a computer network determines the classification of a resource as a network resource.
[Procedural] A resource assumes the status of a network resource once it is allocated to a computer network.
templates.scope_note: Applies to hardware, software, or data assets assigned to a computer network for operational use, such as servers, bandwidth, or storage within enterprise or cloud infrastructures.

templates.manchester_template: Class: {NetworkScrubbingCenter:Class} EquivalentTo: cco:ont00000918 and sdg:performsTrafficCleaning some cco:ont00000665
templates.verbal_template: A network scrubbing center is a telecommunication network node that performs a traffic cleaning function.
verbal_templates: A telecommunication network node is defined as a network scrubbing center when it performs a traffic cleaning function. (Definitional)
A network scrubbing center operates as a telecommunication network node by executing a traffic cleaning function. (Procedural)

templates.manchester_template: Class: {NonDieselPoweredVehicle:Class} EquivalentTo: cco:ont00000053 and sdg:usesNonDieselPowerSource some cco:ont00000477
templates.verbal_template: A non-diesel powered vehicle is a ground motor vehicle that uses a non-diesel power source such as a fuel cell.
verbal_templates: A non-diesel powered vehicle is defined as a ground motor vehicle that operates using a non-diesel power source, such as a fuel cell. (Definitional)
Any ground motor vehicle that utilizes a non-diesel power source, such as a fuel cell, is classified as a non-diesel powered vehicle. (Relational-fronted / Predicate-fronted)
A non-diesel powered vehicle constitutes a ground motor vehicle operating on a non-diesel power source, for example a fuel cell.

templates.manchester_template: Class: {NonprofitOrganization:Class} EquivalentTo: cco:ont00001180 and sdg:operatesForPublicBenefit some bfo:0000015
templates.verbal_template: A nonprofit organization is an organization that operates for a public benefit purpose.
verbal_templates: An organization that operates for public benefit. This entity directs its resources and activities toward serving a public benefit purpose.
Every nonprofit organization belongs to the class of organization precisely because it operates for a public benefit purpose.
Operating for a public benefit purpose constitutes the defining operational characteristic that identifies a nonprofit organization as an organization.
An organization that operates for a public benefit purpose is classified as a nonprofit organization.
templates.scope_note: An organization that operates for public benefit.

templates.manchester_template: Class: {ReferralProcess:Class} EquivalentTo: cco:ont00000769 and sdg:involvesReferral some sdg:ReferralSourceRole
templates.verbal_template: An act of requesting that involves a referral source role.
verbal_templates: A Referral Process encompasses activities that involve requesting services or resources through a referral source role, including client intake and service coordination. This process facilitates the transfer of clients or cases to appropriate service providers based on established criteria. The activity manages referral documentation, tracks referral status, and ensures continuity of care through structured communication protocols.
templates.scope_note: Applies to activities that involve requesting services or resources through a referral source role, including client intake and service coordination.

templates.manchester_template: Class: {RegulatoryAuthority:Class} EquivalentTo: cco:ont00000187 and sdg:exercisesRegulation some cco:ont00001324
templates.verbal_template: An authority role that exercises regulation over a process.
verbal_templates: An authority role is the entity that exercises regulation over a process. (Definitional)
An authority role is the entity that exercises regulation over a process.
An authority role exercises regulation over a process.

templates.manchester_template: Class: {RegulatoryBody:Class} EquivalentTo: bfo:0000040 and sdg:enforcesRegulation some cco:ont00001324
templates.verbal_template: A material entity that enforces a process regulation.
verbal_templates: A regulatory body is a material entity that enforces a process regulation. This body ensures compliance with regulations and monitors regulatory adherence. The body operates within governance structures to enforce process regulations.
A material entity is classified as an entity that enforces a process regulation.
The enforcement of a process regulation is carried out by a material entity.
A material entity maintains a direct enforcement relationship with a process regulation.
templates.scope_note: A regulatory body is a material entity that enforces a process regulation. This body ensures compliance with regulations.

templates.manchester_template: Class: {RenderingEngine:Class} EquivalentTo: cco:ont00000210 and sdg:rendersAnimation some sdg:AnimationSequenceCreation
templates.verbal_template: An engine that renders an animation sequence creation process.
verbal_templates: This term identifies a computational engine that processes animation sequence creation data and renders it into final visual output. Practitioners apply this label when documenting software components, graphics processing units, or rendering farms that convert 3D models, lighting data, and animation timelines into viewable frames for films, games, or simulations.
An engine is defined as a component that renders an animation sequence creation process.
The rendering of an animation sequence creation process is carried out by an engine.
An engine functions by rendering an animation sequence creation process.
templates.scope_note: A computational engine that processes and renders animation sequence creation data into visual output.

templates.manchester_template: Class: {RenderingEnvironment:Class} EquivalentTo: sdg:IndoorEnvironment and sdg:supportsRendering some sdg:RenderedAnimationArtifact
templates.verbal_template: An indoor environment that supports the rendering of an animation artifact.
verbal_templates: This term designates indoor environments configured for animation artifact rendering operations. These spaces contain computing infrastructure, display systems, and controlled lighting conditions necessary for processing digital animation outputs. The environment supports visualization, quality review, and technical validation of rendered animation sequences.
An indoor environment is defined as a space that supports the rendering of an animation artifact.
The rendering of an animation artifact is supported by an indoor environment.
An indoor environment serves as the supporting context for the rendering of an animation artifact.
templates.scope_note: Applies to indoor settings where digital animation artifacts undergo computational rendering processes. Used in computer graphics production, architectural visualization, and virtual reality development workflows.

templates.manchester_template: Class: {ReportingChannel:Class} EquivalentTo: sdg:CommunicationChannel and sdg:transmitsDisclosure some sdg:ProtectedDisclosureProcess
templates.verbal_template: A communication channel that transmits a protected disclosure process.
verbal_templates: A communication channel that transmits a protected disclosure process. This term describes communication pathways, such as hotlines, secure portals, or designated email addresses, that facilitate the submission and processing of protected disclosures, including whistleblower reports or compliance alerts.
templates.scope_note: Applies to communication pathways that transmit protected disclosures, such as whistleblower reports or compliance alerts. Practitioners use this term when designing or managing systems for reporting misconduct, ethical violations, or regulatory concerns within organizations.

templates.manchester_template: Class: {RequestedProviderType:Class} EquivalentTo: sdg:ServiceType and sdg:requestedBy some sdg:ProviderChangeRequestProcess
templates.verbal_template: A service type that is requested by a provider change request process.
verbal_templates: A service type that is requested by a provider change request process. This term applies when a specific service offering is formally requested as part of a modification to an existing service arrangement, capturing the desired state of the service after the change.
A service type is the target of a request made by a provider change request process.
When a provider change request process operates, it requests a service type.
A provider change request process is required to request a service type.
templates.scope_note: Tracks the specific service type requested by a provider change request process. Used to manage service modification requests.

templates.manchester_template: Class: {RequestingClient:Class} EquivalentTo: bfo:0000040 and sdg:makesRequest some sdg:ProviderChangeRequestProcess
templates.verbal_template: A material entity that makes a provider change request process.
verbal_templates: This term identifies a material entity that initiates a provider change request process by submitting formal documentation or digital submissions to service providers. Practitioners use this label when documenting entities such as healthcare organizations, insurance companies, or service departments that request modifications to existing provider networks, service agreements, or account configurations.
A material entity serves as the agent that makes a provider change request process. (Adds "serves as the agent that" - maybe too much)
A material entity is the entity that makes a provider change request process.
The provider change request process is made by a material entity.
templates.scope_note: A material entity that initiates a provider change request process through formal communication.

templates.manchester_template: Class: {RequestingEntity:Class} EquivalentTo: bfo:0000040 and sdg:submitsRequest some sdg:DuplicatingRequest
templates.verbal_template: A material entity that submits a duplicating request.
verbal_templates: A RequestingEntity is a material entity that submits a duplicating request. It identifies the entity that initiates the request for duplication. This term applies when a material entity makes a formal request for a duplicate.
A material entity is defined by its submission of a duplicating request.
The submission of a duplicating request is carried out by a material entity.
A material entity serves as the source of a submitted duplicating request.
templates.scope_note: A RequestingEntity is a material entity that submits a duplicating request.

templates.manchester_template: Class: {ResearchActivity:Class} EquivalentTo: sdg:ResearchProcess and sdg:conductedBy some sdg:YoungResearcherRole
templates.verbal_template: A research process that is conducted by a young researcher role.
verbal_templates: A research process that is conducted by a young researcher role. This term captures scientific investigations, data analysis, or experimental work actively performed by early-career researchers, such as doctoral candidates or postdoctoral fellows, often supported by mentorship or targeted funding programs.
A research process is characterized as a process conducted by a young researcher role.
The agent that conducts a research process is a young researcher role.
A young researcher role performs the conducting of a research process.
templates.scope_note: Applies to research processes actively conducted by young researchers, such as doctoral candidates or early-career scientists. Practitioners use this term when tracking research outputs, funding allocations, or mentorship initiatives focused on emerging scholars.

templates.manchester_template: Class: {FacilityInfrastructure:Class} EquivalentTo: cco:ont00000192 and sdg:includes some cco:ont00000328
templates.verbal_template: A facility that includes transportation infrastructure.
verbal_templates: A facility that includes transportation infrastructure. This term applies to the physical structures and systems within a facility that support the movement of people and goods, including roads, walkways, and loading docks.
A facility is defined as an entity that includes transportation infrastructure. (Definitional)
A facility is characterized by its inclusion of transportation infrastructure.
Transportation infrastructure is included within a facility.
templates.scope_note: Tracks the physical infrastructure components of a facility. Used to manage and maintain physical assets.

templates.manchester_template: Class: {FinalInspectionProcess:Class} EquivalentTo: cco:ont00000908 and sdg:has_objective some cco:ont00001224
templates.verbal_template: An act of material artifact processing that has the objective of a process requirement.
verbal_templates: An act that performs material artifact processing is defined by having a process requirement as its objective.
When material artifact processing occurs as an act, a process requirement functions as its objective.
A process requirement serves as the objective for an act that executes material artifact processing.

templates.manchester_template: Class: {FinancialFund:Class} EquivalentTo: cco:ont00001295 and sdg:involves some sdg:FinancialResource
templates.verbal_template: A financial facility that involves a financial resource.
verbal_templates: A financial facility that involves a financial resource. This entity serves as a container or mechanism for financial resources. The entity facilitates the aggregation and management of financial resources.
A financial facility is defined as an entity that involves a financial resource.
The involvement of a financial resource is attributed to a financial facility.
Upon classification of a financial facility, the system records that it involves a financial resource.
templates.scope_note: A financial facility that involves a financial resource. This entity serves as a container or mechanism for financial resources.

templates.manchester_template: Class: {FinancialManagementProcess:Class} EquivalentTo: sdg:FinancialActivity and sdg:involves some sdg:FinancialStrategyOversight
templates.verbal_template: A financial activity that involves financial strategy oversight.
verbal_templates: A financial activity is an activity that involves financial strategy oversight.
Financial strategy oversight is involved in a financial activity.
When a financial activity is present, it includes financial strategy oversight.

templates.manchester_template: Class: {FinancialProduct:Class} EquivalentTo: cco:ont00000537 and sdg:has_function some cco:ont00000938
templates.verbal_template: A financial instrument that has the function of a financial artifact function.
verbal_templates: This term captures financial instruments that function as tradeable assets or liabilities in capital markets. The instrument operates as a financial artifact enabling investment, financing, or risk transfer activities. Market participants deploy these instruments for portfolio construction, hedging strategies, or liquidity management.
A financial instrument is defined by its possession of the function of a financial artifact.
The function of a financial instrument is to serve as a financial artifact.
A financial instrument fulfills the designated function of a financial artifact.
templates.scope_note: A financial instrument serving as a tradeable asset or liability within capital markets.

templates.manchester_template: Class: {FinancialReport:Class} EquivalentTo: cco:ont00000958 and sdg:concerns some sdg:FinancialResource
templates.verbal_template: An information content entity that concerns a financial resource.
verbal_templates: An information content entity that concerns a financial resource. This entity represents a document or data set related to financial resources. The entity conveys information about financial resources through structured data or text.
An information content entity is defined as any entity that concerns a financial resource.
A financial resource serves as the subject of concern for an information content entity.
An entity is designated as an information content entity precisely when it concerns a financial resource.
templates.scope_note: An information content entity that concerns a financial resource. This entity represents a document or data set related to financial resources.

templates.manchester_template: Class: {FinancialResource:Class} EquivalentTo: cco:ont00000608 and sdg:used_for some sdg:FinancialActivity
templates.verbal_template: A financial value used for a financial activity.
verbal_templates: A Financial Resource is a financial value used for a financial activity. This resource includes funds, credit, or investments. The value supports operational needs and strategic initiatives.
A financial value is defined as an amount applied to a financial activity.
A financial activity is associated with a financial value that serves as its input.
A financial value qualifies as such when it is employed in the execution of a financial activity.
templates.scope_note: A Financial Resource is a financial value used for a financial activity. This resource includes funds, credit, or investments. The value supports operational needs and strategic initiatives.

templates.manchester_template: Class: {HealthRecordTransferProcess:Class} EquivalentTo: cco:ont00001330 and sdg:transfers_health_record_data some sdg:ClinicalQualityData
templates.verbal_template: A telemetry process that conveys health record data between systems.
verbal_templates: A telemetry process is one that conveys health record data between systems.
Health record data is conveyed between systems by a telemetry process.
Conveying health record data between systems is the activity performed by a telemetry process.

templates.manchester_template: Class: {HealthcareNetworkInfrastructure:Class} EquivalentTo: cco:ont00000870 and sdg:supports_healthcare_services some cco:ont00000700
templates.verbal_template: An infrastructure system that provides the underlying network support for healthcare services.
verbal_templates: Healthcare Network Infrastructure constitutes the underlying network support system that facilitates the delivery of healthcare services. It includes the computer networks, servers, and communication channels that connect healthcare facilities, enabling the transmission of patient data, clinical information, and operational communications. This infrastructure ensures reliable and secure connectivity for healthcare operations, supporting the continuous provision of medical services and patient care.
An infrastructure system is defined as the entity that delivers the underlying network support for healthcare services.
The underlying network support for healthcare services is supplied by an infrastructure system.
An infrastructure system performs the function of providing the underlying network support for healthcare services.
templates.scope_note: This term designates the physical and logical network components that provide connectivity for healthcare services within a designated operational area. It encompasses the hardware, software, and communication protocols that enable data exchange between healthcare facilities, providers, and patients.

templates.manchester_template: Class: {HealthcareOrganization:Class} EquivalentTo: cco:ont00001180 and sdg:provides_healthcare_services some cco:ont00000055
templates.verbal_template: An organization that delivers healthcare services through healthcare facilities.
verbal_templates: A HealthcareOrganization is an Organization that provides healthcare services through healthcare facilities. It defines the entity responsible for delivering medical care. This term applies when an organization operates healthcare facilities to provide services.
templates.scope_note: A HealthcareOrganization is an Organization that provides healthcare services through healthcare facilities.

templates.manchester_template: Class: {HeightMeasurement:Class} EquivalentTo: cco:ont00000120 and sdg:quantifies_vertical_extent some cco:ont00000967
templates.verbal_template: A measurement unit that quantifies the vertical extent or height of an entity.
verbal_templates: A measurement unit that quantifies the vertical extent or height of an entity. This concept captures the physical distance from the base to the top of an object or structure, as recorded by precision instruments like laser levels or calipers.
A measurement unit refers to a standard used to quantify the vertical extent or height of an entity.
templates.scope_note: Applies to the measurement of vertical dimensions in manufacturing, construction, and physics contexts.

templates.manchester_template: Class: {HorseIdentity:Class} EquivalentTo: cco:ont00000923 and sdg:designates_horse some cco:ont00000562
templates.verbal_template: An arbitrary identifier that uniquely designates a specific horse.
verbal_templates: An arbitrary identifier that uniquely designates a specific horse. This identifier serves as the primary reference for linking records and managing the lifecycle of the animal.
An identifier is defined as the unique designator for a specific horse.
A specific horse is uniquely designated by an identifier.
An identifier uniquely designates a specific horse.
templates.scope_note: Applies to an arbitrary identifier that uniquely designates a specific horse within a registry or tracking system.

templates.manchester_template: Class: {HousingClient:Class} EquivalentTo: bfo:0000040 and sdg:enters_rental_agreement some cco:ont00001325
templates.verbal_template: A material entity that enters into a rental agreement for housing.
verbal_templates: A material entity that enters into a rental agreement for housing. This term describes individuals or organizations that participate in housing rental arrangements through formal agreements. The concept encompasses all material entities engaging in housing rental transactions, from individual residents to organizational entities participating in structured housing rental agreements.
A material entity is classified as such when it enters into a rental agreement for housing.
The party that enters into a rental agreement for housing is a material entity.
A material entity enters into a rental agreement for housing, establishing the stated relationship.
templates.scope_note: Applies to material entities that enter into rental agreements for housing purposes. Used when documenting individuals or entities participating in housing rental arrangements.

templates.manchester_template: Class: {HousingDebtIssue:Class} EquivalentTo: cco:ont00001073 and sdg:originates_from_rental some cco:ont00001325
templates.verbal_template: A financial value of property that arises from a rental agreement.
verbal_templates: A financial value of property that arises from a rental agreement. This term captures the specific financial instrument tied to housing debt, where the underlying asset and cash flows originate from rental income streams. Practitioners use this to track and manage debt securities backed by rental properties.
A financial value of property is the amount derived from a rental agreement.
A rental agreement serves as the basis from which a financial value of property arises.
The financial value of property originates within a rental agreement.
templates.scope_note: Applies to financial instruments representing property debt obligations arising directly from rental agreements.

templates.manchester_template: Class: {HousingPolicyTopic:Class} EquivalentTo: bfo:0000031 and sdg:addresses_housing_matters some cco:ont00001325
templates.verbal_template: A generically dependent continuant that addresses matters related to housing rentals.

templates.manchester_template: Class: {HumanAgent:Class} EquivalentTo: cco:ont00001017 and sdg:encompasses_human_person some cco:ont00001262
templates.verbal_template: An agent that encompasses or is constituted by a human person.
verbal_templates: An agent that encompasses or is constituted by a human person. This term applies to any individual acting in a professional or official capacity, where the agent role is directly tied to the biological and social identity of a specific person.
An entity qualifies as an agent when it encompasses a human person or is constituted by a human person.
The encompassing or constituting of a human person defines the agent in question.
An agent is defined as an entity that encompasses or is constituted by a human person.
templates.scope_note: Identifies an agent that encompasses or is constituted by a human person. Used to distinguish human actors from organizational entities.

templates.manchester_template: Class: {ImagingEquipment:Class} EquivalentTo: cco:ont00000771 and sdg:facilitates_diagnostic_procedures some sdg:DiagnosticImaging
templates.verbal_template: An imaging instrument that facilitates diagnostic imaging procedures.
verbal_templates: This term identifies specialized imaging instruments that facilitate diagnostic imaging procedures for clinical patient assessment. Practitioners apply this label when documenting MRI scanners, CT machines, ultrasound systems, or X-ray equipment used by radiologists and clinicians to visualize internal structures, detect abnormalities, and guide treatment decisions in medical facilities.
templates.scope_note: A specialized instrument that facilitates diagnostic imaging procedures for clinical assessment.

templates.manchester_template: Class: {IndependentEconomicAgent:Class} EquivalentTo: cco:ont00001017 and sdg:engages_in_market_exchange some sdg:ExternalBusinessPartner
templates.verbal_template: An agent that engages in market exchange with external business partners.
verbal_templates: An Independent Economic Agent functions as an autonomous decision-maker that participates in market exchanges with external business partners. This entity maintains operational independence, negotiates contracts, and manages resources to achieve economic objectives. The agent engages in strategic market activities, including procurement, sales, and investment, to sustain its economic viability and competitive positioning.
An agent is defined as a participant that engages in market exchange with external business partners.
Engagement in market exchange with external business partners is conducted by an agent.
An agent engages in market exchange with external business partners.
templates.scope_note: Applies to economic entities that participate in market exchanges as autonomous decision-makers, independent of other organizations.

templates.manchester_template: Class: {Individual:Class} EquivalentTo: bfo:0000040 and sdg:constitutes_human_person some cco:ont00001262
templates.verbal_template: A material entity that constitutes a human person.
verbal_templates: A material entity that constitutes a human person. This term captures the physical human being as the foundational subject in legal, medical, and administrative documentation, serving as the primary entity for consent, treatment, or claim processing.
A material entity is defined as anything that constitutes a human person.
The constituting relation holds from a material entity to a human person.
Model a material entity as the constituent of a human person.
templates.scope_note: Applies to any material entity that physically constitutes a human person in legal, medical, or administrative contexts. Practitioners use this term when documenting the biological subject of a study, patient, or claimant in formal records.

templates.manchester_template: Class: {ObservatoryMountingStructure:Class} EquivalentTo: cco:ont00001042 and sdg:supportsObservatoryInstrument some cco:ont00001009
templates.verbal_template: An equipment mount that supports an observatory instrument.
verbal_templates: An equipment mount that supports an observatory instrument. This structure provides the physical foundation and stabilization required for optical telescope operations.
The support relationship holds between an equipment mount and an observatory instrument.
An equipment mount serves to support an observatory instrument.
An equipment mount is the component that supports an observatory instrument.
templates.scope_note: This term represents an equipment mount that supports an observatory instrument.

templates.manchester_template: Class: {OfflineChannel:Class} EquivalentTo: sdg:DisseminationChannel and sdg:utilizesOfflineMedia some cco:ont00000859
templates.verbal_template: A dissemination channel that utilizes offline media.
verbal_templates: An Offline Channel is a dissemination channel that utilizes offline media. This channel includes television broadcasts, radio, and print. The channel reaches audiences through non-digital platforms.
A dissemination channel that utilizes offline media relies on offline media for its operation. (adds "for its operation" - maybe too much)
A dissemination channel that utilizes offline media employs offline media as its medium.
Offline media are utilized by a dissemination channel of this classification.
templates.scope_note: An Offline Channel is a dissemination channel that utilizes offline media. This channel includes television broadcasts, radio, and print. The channel reaches audiences through non-digital platforms.

templates.manchester_template: Class: {OnlineChannel:Class} EquivalentTo: sdg:DisseminationChannel and sdg:utilizesOnlineMedia some cco:ont00001183
templates.verbal_template: A dissemination channel that utilizes online media.
verbal_templates: A dissemination channel that utilizes online media. This term describes communication pathways that leverage internet infrastructure, such as websites, social media platforms, or digital messaging systems, to distribute information to target audiences.
A dissemination channel is defined by its utilization of online media.
A dissemination channel functions
Online media are utilized by the dissemination channel.
templates.scope_note: Applies to digital communication pathways that leverage internet infrastructure for information dissemination. Practitioners use this term when designing or analyzing outreach strategies that rely on websites, social media, or digital messaging platforms.

templates.manchester_template: Class: {OperationalDisruption:Class} EquivalentTo: cco:ont00001213 and sdg:impactsOperationalArea some cco:ont00000567
templates.verbal_template: A stasis of artifact operationality that impacts an operational area.
verbal_templates: Operational Disruption refers to a state of stasis in artifact operationality that impacts an operational area, resulting in a temporary halt or reduction of normal activities. This condition affects the ability to perform tasks, utilize resources, or deliver services within the designated operational area. The disruption may involve delays, pauses, or interruptions in the execution of processes, impacting the efficiency and effectiveness of operations.
templates.scope_note: This term identifies a state of halted or impaired operational activity within a specific operational area, affecting the delivery of services or functions. It represents a temporary cessation or reduction in the normal functioning of processes, systems, or resources within the defined operational context.

templates.manchester_template: Class: {OperationalEffectiveness:Class} EquivalentTo: cco:ont00001191 and sdg:evaluatesOperationalArea some cco:ont00000567
templates.verbal_template: An operational stasis that evaluates an operational area.
verbal_templates: An operational stasis that evaluates an operational area. The stasis captures the state where performance metrics, resource allocation, and outcome measures are assessed within a specific operational area to determine effectiveness.
An operational stasis is defined as the entity that evaluates an operational area.
The evaluation of an operational area is performed by an operational stasis.
An operational stasis is required to evaluate an operational area.
templates.scope_note: This operational stasis evaluates an operational area by measuring performance metrics within defined boundaries. The stasis applies in military, emergency response, or organizational contexts where area effectiveness is assessed through structured evaluation.

templates.manchester_template: Class: {OperationalEquipment:Class} EquivalentTo: cco:ont00000870 and bfo:0000178 some cco:ont00000567
templates.verbal_template: Infrastructure systems or apparatus deployed to support activities within an operational area.
verbal_templates: This term designates infrastructure systems and apparatus deployed within operational areas to support field activities. Operational equipment includes machinery, communication systems, and support apparatus necessary for mission execution. These systems enable resource deployment, activity coordination, and operational capability maintenance within designated areas.
Infrastructure systems or apparatus constitute equipment that is deployed to support activities within an operational area.
To support activities within an operational area, infrastructure systems or apparatus are deployed.
Activities within an operational area are supported by deployed infrastructure systems or apparatus.
templates.scope_note: Applies to physical systems and apparatus deployed within operational areas to support field activities. Used in military operations, emergency response coordination, and industrial site management.

templates.manchester_template: Class: {OperationalProtocol:Class} EquivalentTo: sdg:MonitoringProtocol and bfo:0000056 some bfo:0000015
templates.verbal_template: Changed the filler of realized_by from a continuant (ont00000567) to a process (bfo:0000015) to match the property range.
verbal_templates: Defines a standardized procedure or set of rules governing activities within a specific operational area or site. This entity ensures consistent execution of tasks and maintains safety standards in operational environments.
The property realized_by is defined to take a process (bfo:0000015) as its filler, replacing the prior continuant (ont00000567) value in accordance with the property range.
The filler for realized_by was updated from a continuant (ont00000567) to a process (bfo:0000015), thereby aligning the value type with the specified property range.
The range of realized_by is constrained to a process (bfo:0000015), superseding the previous continuant (ont00000567) assignment to satisfy the property range requirement.
templates.scope_note: Used to document standardized rules and procedures governing daily activities within a specific operational area or site.

templates.manchester_template: Class: {OperationalUnit:Class} EquivalentTo: cco:ont00000172 and cco:ont00001901 some sdg:PoliceOfficerRole
templates.verbal_template: A functional unit that bears a police officer role.
verbal_templates: A base of operations or organizational entity comprising law enforcement personnel. This entity serves as a physical or organizational location for police officers. The entity provides the structural framework for police officer roles.
A functional unit is defined as an entity that bears a police officer role.
The bearing of a police officer role is carried out by a functional unit.
A functional unit must bear a police officer role.
templates.scope_note: A base of operations or organizational entity comprising law enforcement personnel. This entity serves as a physical or organizational location for police officers.

templates.manchester_template: Class: {OrderConstraint:Class} EquivalentTo: cco:ont00001041 and bfo:0000056 some sdg:PromotionalCalendarOrder
templates.verbal_template: A sequence position or ordinal rule that restricts the arrangement of items in a promotional calendar.
verbal_templates: This term encompasses rules that define the required sequence, position, or ordinal arrangement of items within promotional calendars, marketing campaigns, or scheduling systems. Practitioners apply it to classify organizational frameworks that specify item ordering requirements, positional dependencies, and sequence dependencies for promotional content deployment.
A sequence position or ordinal rule is defined as a constraint that limits how items are arranged within a promotional calendar.
When applied to a promotional calendar, a sequence position or ordinal rule limits the possible arrangements of items.
The arrangement of items in a promotional calendar is restricted by a sequence position or ordinal rule.
templates.scope_note: Applies to rules that define the required sequence, position, or ordinal arrangement of items within promotional calendars, marketing campaigns, or scheduling systems.

templates.manchester_template: Class: {OrganizationMember:Class} EquivalentTo: cco:ont00000175 and bfo:0000178 some cco:ont00001180
templates.verbal_template: A role held by an individual or entity that is part of an organization.
verbal_templates: Designates an individual or entity holding a formal membership role within an organization's structure. This entity represents the active affiliation of a participant with the organizational body.
A role is held by an individual or entity that belongs to an organization. (Definitional)
An individual or entity that is part of an organization holds a role. (Active/Relational-fronted)
A role is defined as a position occupied by an individual or entity that belongs to an organization.
templates.scope_note: Applies to individuals or entities holding a formal membership role within an organization's structure.

templates.manchester_template: Class: {OrganizationalAgent:Class} EquivalentTo: cco:ont00001017 and bfo:0000056 some sdg:FinancialPlanningProcess

verbal_templates: An agent acting on behalf of an organization during financial planning activities. This term identifies individuals or roles that execute financial planning tasks, such as budgeting, investment analysis, or fiscal strategy development, on behalf of an organization.
An agent is defined as an entity that acts on behalf of an organization during financial planning activities.
The agent performs actions on behalf of an organization throughout financial planning activities.
The organization is represented by an agent during financial planning activities.
templates.scope_note: Applies to agents acting on behalf of an organization during financial planning activities. Practitioners use this term when documenting roles responsible for budgeting, investment strategy, or fiscal decision-making within corporate or institutional settings.

templates.manchester_template: Class: {OrganizationalFunction:Class} EquivalentTo: cco:ont00000568 and sdg:GeneralManagerRole
templates.verbal_template: A capability of an organization that realizes the duties of a general manager.
verbal_templates: An organizational function is a capability of an organization that realizes the duties of a general manager. This capability directs organizational activities and resources. The function supports general manager duties and organizational operations.
A capability of an organization is defined as the entity that realizes the duties of a general manager.
The duties of a general manager are realized by a capability of an organization.
A capability of an organization proceeds to realize the duties of a general manager. (A bit odd)
templates.scope_note: An organizational function is a capability of an organization. This capability realizes the duties of a general manager.

templates.manchester_template: Class: {OrganizationalHealthMetric:Class} EquivalentTo: sdg:HealthOutcomeMetric and bfo:0000056 some sdg:EmployeeFeedbackSurvey
templates.verbal_template: A health outcome measure derived from or applied to employee feedback surveys.
verbal_templates: An organizational health metric quantifies employee wellbeing, workplace safety, or cultural health through structured survey data. The term encompasses indicators derived from employee feedback, engagement assessments, or health evaluations used to monitor workforce conditions and improve organizational performance.
A health outcome measure is defined as any metric that is either derived from employee feedback surveys or applied to them.
Employee feedback surveys serve as the source from which a health outcome measure is derived, or as the target to which that measure is applied.
To qualify as a health outcome measure in this context, a metric must originate from employee feedback surveys or be directed toward them.
templates.scope_note: Applies when measuring employee wellbeing, workplace safety, or organizational culture through survey data. This term covers metrics derived from employee feedback, engagement surveys, or health assessments.

templates.manchester_template: Class: {OrganizationalLeadershipRole:Class} EquivalentTo: cco:ont00000768 and bfo:0000178 some sdg:ExecutiveLeadershipProcess
templates.verbal_template: An organizational member role that is realized during executive leadership activities.
verbal_templates: An organizational member role that is realized during executive leadership activities. This term applies to positions of authority within an organization that involve strategic decision-making and the direction of organizational activities.
An organizational member role is a role that is realized during executive leadership activities.
Executive leadership activities are the period during which an organizational member role is realized.
The realization of an organizational member role takes place during executive leadership activities.

templates.manchester_template: Class: {OzoneOxygenMixture:Class} EquivalentTo: cco:ont00000897 and bfo:0000056 some sdg:OzoneTherapySession

verbal_templates: A portion of oxidizer used as a therapeutic agent in ozone therapy sessions. This term refers to the specific gas mixture administered to patients for medical purposes. It is prepared and utilized in controlled clinical settings to deliver therapeutic benefits through ozone exposure.
A therapeutic agent in ozone therapy sessions is defined as a portion of oxidizer.
During ozone therapy sessions, the therapeutic agent administered is a specific portion of oxidizer.
The portion of oxidizer that serves as a therapeutic agent belongs to the category of substances utilized in ozone therapy sessions.
templates.scope_note: Applies to medical preparations containing a mixture of ozone and oxygen used in therapeutic treatments.

templates.manchester_template: Class: {AcademicDegree:Class} EquivalentTo: bfo:0000031 and sdg:conferredBy some sdg:HigherEducationInstitution and sdg:signifiesCompletionOf some sdg:AcademicCurriculumProgram
templates.verbal_template: An academic degree is a generically dependent continuant that signifies the completion of an academic curriculum program and is conferred by a higher education institution.

templates.manchester_template: Class: {CalendarProduct:Class} EquivalentTo: bfo:0000031 and sdg:implements some cco:ont00000891 and sdg:specifiesTemporalReferenceFor some cco:ont00000259

verbal_templates: A calendar product is classified as a generically dependent continuant that implements a calendar system and specifies temporal references for calendar months.
The implementation of a calendar system and the specification of temporal references for calendar months characterize a calendar product as a generically dependent continuant.
Any generically dependent continuant that implements a calendar system and specifies temporal references for calendar months qualifies as a calendar product.

templates.manchester_template: Class: {CallVolume:Class} EquivalentTo: bfo:0000019 and sdg:measures some cco:ont00001190

templates.manchester_template: Class: {Child:Class} EquivalentTo: cco:ont00001262 and sdg:hasAge some sdg:Age and sdg:hasBiologicalParent some cco:ont00001262

verbal_templates: A child denotes a person situated in the early developmental stage of life who possesses at least one biological parent.

A child is defined as a person situated in the early developmental stage of life who possesses at least one biological parent.

templates.manchester_template: Class: {ClinicalCare:Class} EquivalentTo: bfo:0000015 and sdg:involvesAgent some sdg:IndividualClinician and sdg:hasPatient some sdg:Patient

verbal_templates: Clinical care denotes a process wherein a clinician delivers medical services to a patient for the purpose of diagnosing, treating, or preventing disease.
When a clinician administers medical services to a patient with the aim of diagnosing, treating, or preventing disease, the resulting activity constitutes a process known as clinical care.
In the process of clinical care, a clinician supplies medical services to a patient specifically to diagnose, treat, or prevent disease.

templates.manchester_template: Class: {CommunicationSecurityAspect:Class} EquivalentTo: bfo:0000019 and sdg:pertainsTo some sdg:CommunicationChannel and sdg:ensuresSecurityOf some cco:ont00001036

verbal_templates: A communication security aspect constitutes a quality associated with a communication channel that ensures the security of a communication system.
Pertaining to a communication channel, a communication security aspect serves as a quality that ensures the security of a communication system.
The security of a communication system is ensured by a communication security aspect, which is a quality pertaining to a communication channel.

templates.manchester_template: Class: {ConstructedPredicate:Class} EquivalentTo: bfo:0000031 and sdg:encodesLogicalRelation some cco:ont00000965 and sdg:appliesTo some cco:ont00001037

verbal_templates: A constructed predicate is a generically dependent continuant that encodes a logical relation from a prescriptive information entity and applies to a constructed feature. (Too similar to original)

When encoding a logical relation derived from a prescriptive information entity and applying to a constructed feature, a constructed predicate operates as a generically dependent continuant.

verbal_templates: A continuous emissions monitoring process is classified as a sensing process that continuously monitors emissions originating from an industrial emission source.
Emissions from an industrial emission source are continuously monitored by the continuous emissions monitoring process, which operates as a sensing process.
The continuous emissions monitoring process functions as a sensing process that performs continuous monitoring of emissions released by an industrial emission source.

templates.manchester_template: Class: {CorporateActivity:Class} EquivalentTo: sdg:OrganizationalActivity and sdg:conductedBy some cco:ont00000443

verbal_templates: Corporate activity constitutes an organizational activity performed by a commercial organization to further its business objectives.

templates.manchester_template: Class: {CorporateAuditProcess:Class} EquivalentTo: bfo:0000015 and sdg:examinesRecordsOf some cco:ont00000443 and sdg:verifiesComplianceWith some sdg:AuditMethodology

verbal_templates: A corporate audit process is defined as a procedure that examines the records of a commercial organization and verifies compliance with established audit methodologies.
The corporate audit process performs two functions: it examines the records of a commercial organization and verifies compliance with established audit methodologies.
Examination of the records of a commercial organization and verification of compliance with established audit methodologies constitute the corporate audit process.

templates.manchester_template: Class: {CorporateEmploymentProcess:Class} EquivalentTo: cco:ont00001226 and sdg:involvesAgent some cco:ont00000443 and sdg:resultsInRole some sdg:CorporateEmployee
templates.verbal_template: Corporate employment process is an act of employment by an organization that involves a commercial agent and results in a corporate employee role.
verbal_templates: A corporate employment process constitutes an organizational act of employment that engages a commercial agent and yields a corporate employee role.
An act of employment carried out by an organization, which includes a commercial agent, constitutes a corporate employment process that produces a corporate employee role.
The corporate employment process proceeds as an organizational act of employment involving a commercial agent, culminating in a corporate employee role.

templates.manchester_template: Class: {CorporateReputation:Class} EquivalentTo: bfo:0000019 and sdg:reflectsPerceptionOf some cco:ont00000443 and sdg:heldBy some sdg:StakeholderRole

verbal_templates: Corporate reputation denotes a quality that reflects the perception of a commercial organization and is held by stakeholder roles.
The perception of a commercial organization is reflected by a quality called corporate reputation, which is held by stakeholder roles.
Stakeholder roles hold the quality known as corporate reputation, reflecting the perception of a commercial organization.

templates.manchester_template: Class: {Course:Class} EquivalentTo: bfo:0000031 and sdg:hasCurriculum some sdg:AcademicCurriculumProgram and sdg:deliveredBy some sdg:HigherEducationInstitution
templates.verbal_template: A course is a generically dependent continuant that constitutes a structured educational program with a defined curriculum and is delivered by a higher education institution.

templates.manchester_template: Class: {CriminalJusticeProcess:Class} EquivalentTo: bfo:0000015 and bfo:0000056 some sdg:CriminalJusticeAdministration
templates.verbal_template: A criminal justice process that is realized in an administration process.
verbal_templates: A criminal justice process is a process that is realized within an administration process.
The realization of a criminal justice process occurs in an administration process.
An administration process is the process in which a criminal justice process is realized.

templates.manchester_template: Class: {CustomerDevice:Class} EquivalentTo: bfo:0000040 and bfo:0000178 some sdg:CustomerNetwork

verbal_templates: The substitution of realized_in with has_continuant_part was executed to align with the continuant range constraint when relating devices to networks.
When relating devices to networks, the required continuant range is satisfied by replacing realized_in with has_continuant_part.
The relation realized_in is superseded by has_continuant_part so that the continuant range matches the requirement for linking devices to networks.

templates.manchester_template: Class: {DatabaseContainer:Class} EquivalentTo: cco:ont00000020 and sdg:usedForStorage some sdg:CloudStorageVolume

verbal_templates: A container functions as a storage unit located within a cloud storage volume.

Within a cloud storage volume, a container fulfills a storage function.

templates.manchester_template: Class: sdg:DecisionAction EquivalentTo: bfo:0000015 and cco:ont00001777 some sdg:DecisionMakingProcess
templates.verbal_template: An action that is a part of a decision-making process.
verbal_templates: This concept is defined as an action that constitutes a constituent element within a decision-making process.

templates.manchester_template: Class: {DecisionTransitionAction:Class} EquivalentTo: bfo:0000015 and bfo:0000056 some sdg:DecisionMakingProcess

verbal_templates: A decision transition action constitutes an occurrent process that is realized within a decision making process.
A decision making process realizes an occurrent process classified as a decision transition action.
The occurrent process instantiated within a decision making process is identified as a decision transition action.

templates.manchester_template: Class: {DiagnosticImaging:Class} EquivalentTo: bfo:0000015 and sdg:facilitated_by some sdg:ImagingEquipment

verbal_templates: The term designates a class of processes that serve diagnostic purposes and are enabled by imaging equipment.

templates.manchester_template: Class: {EthicalInvestment:Class} EquivalentTo: bfo:0000015 and sdg:hasPurpose some sdg:EthicalInvestmentAsset
templates.verbal_template: A financial activity that has an ethical investment asset as its purpose.
verbal_templates: A financial activity is defined as an entity whose purpose is an ethical investment asset.

templates.manchester_template: Class: {EthicalStandard:Class} EquivalentTo: cco:ont00000575 and sdg:hasStandard some sdg:EthicalRequirement
templates.verbal_template: A quality specification that serves as a standard for an ethical requirement.

templates.manchester_template: Class: {ExecutiveDirection:Class} EquivalentTo: bfo:0000015 and sdg:hasResponsibility some sdg:ExecutiveDirectorFunction

templates.manchester_template: Class: {ExecutiveImplementation:Class} EquivalentTo: bfo:0000015 and sdg:hasPurpose some sdg:ExecutiveExecutionFunction
templates.verbal_template: A process that serves as the purpose of an executive execution function.
verbal_templates: The purpose of an executive execution function is constituted by a process.
An executive execution function designates a process to act as its purpose.
A process is characterized as the purpose fulfilled by an executive execution function.

templates.manchester_template: Class: {ExecutiveLeadershipRole:Class} EquivalentTo: sdg:OrganizationalLeadershipRole and sdg:hasMember some sdg:ExecutiveLeadershipProcess

templates.manchester_template: Class: {ExternalBusinessPartner:Class} EquivalentTo: cco:ont00000599 and sdg:hasRelationship some sdg:ExternalAgency and sdg:engages_in_market_exchange some sdg:IndependentEconomicAgent
templates.verbal_template: An interpersonal relationship role that has a relationship with an external agency and engages in market exchange with an independent economic agent.
verbal_templates: An interpersonal relationship role is defined by its connection to an external agency and its participation in market exchange with an independent economic agent.

An external agency relates to an interpersonal relationship role, which simultaneously engages in market exchange with an independent economic agent.

templates.manchester_template: Class: {FinancialInstrument:Class} EquivalentTo: sdg:FinancialProduct and bfo:0000056 some {ClearingFunction:Class}

verbal_templates: A financial instrument constitutes a specific category of financial product defined by its realization of a clearing function.

templates.manchester_template: Class: {FinancialStrategyOversight:Class} EquivalentTo: bfo:0000015 and bfo:0000056 some sdg:FinancialManagementProcess
